title: Batch run record (one line of a run history)
description: One JSON line per run, appended to an append-only history whatever the outcome (ADR-0101 §1–§2). Written and checked by scripts/python/run_record.py. Counts and identifiers only, never data values.

run_id.description: <pipeline>-<started_at as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>. Unique in the history: a rerun is a new run.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD, recorded before the first step.

dirty.description: The working tree had uncommitted or untracked changes at the start.

production.description: A production run. With dirty: true it is refused, and recorded as aborted with no steps.

status.description: aborted: interrupted, or refused before its first step. A succeeded run has only succeeded steps.

steps.description: The steps that started, in order. A step after the one that failed is not listed.

reconciliations.description: ADR-0103 §2. Present when the pipeline declares reconciliations: one verdict per declaration, a declared one the run never reached being not_run. A succeeded run has no break or not_run.
